content: Analyst first-cut sizing: I_tail~56uA (mn4=6), I_2~90uA (mn5=9), balanced with mp3=12, mp1=4. Cc=1.0pF, Rc=4.5k provides LHP zero at 43 MHz boosting PM to 66.4 deg. Simulated candidate 1: gain 723 V/V, PM 66.4 deg, SR 37.2 V/us, noise 17.4 mV, current 177 uA, area 6.95e-10 m^2. Only binding violation is UGBW at 45.9 MHz, limited by second pole gm6/CL and Cc. Handing over to diagnoser to target UGBW.

Candidate 1: single violation is UGBW (45.9 MHz vs 100 MHz, z=-0.371). All other specs pass with margin (gain=723, PM=66.4 deg, SR=37.2 V/us, noise=17.4 mV, current=177 uA). Operating point shows p2=19.5 MHz and gm1/(2piCc)=93.6 MHz. Chosen lever: lower Cc to 0.4-0.7 pF and retune Rc to boost UGBW while preserving PM via LHP zero phase lead.

Simulated id 2: Cc lowered to 0.7pF, Rc raised to 5k. As predicted, UGBW improved from 45.9 MHz to 53.6 MHz, phm maintained at 60.4 deg, reward improved from -0.3435 to -0.2727. Second pole gm6/CL remains the bottleneck at 19.5 MHz.

Candidate 2 has UGBW=53.6 MHz (z=-0.302) as sole violation. Operating point shows gm6=1.22 mS sets p2=19.5 MHz, which limits UGBW. Chosen lever: boost gm6 by allocating more current to stage 2 (I_2~100uA via mn5=10, I_tail~40uA via mn4=4) and widening mp3 (mp3=20, mp1=4, wp1=wp3=2.0um) maintaining exact balance condition 2*S5/S4 = S_mp3/S_mp1 = 5.0. Ask sizer to screen with Cc/Rc variants.

Simulated id 3: gm6 boosted (mn5=11, mp3=11, wp3=2.5u) and gm1 boosted (mn1=22, wn1=2.75u), Cc=0.6pF, Rc=7.5k. Reward jumped from -0.2727 to -0.0524. UGBW reached 86.5 MHz (z=-0.072), PM reached 59.84 deg (z=-0.0014, within 0.16 deg of passing). All other specs comfortably pass (gain=753, noise=13.1mV, SR=52.3, current=199uA).

Simulated id 4: FEASIBLE ACHIEVED! Reward=0.6529. All hard constraints pass: UGBW=100.6 MHz (>=100), PM=60.57 deg (>=60), gain=753 V/V (>=200), SR=48.9 V/us (>=30), noise=13.0 mV (<=30). Area=8.14e-10 m^2, current=229.5 uA. Handing over to phase 2 optimization.
Simulated id 5: mn1 reduced to 18*2.5u. FoM improved to 0.6606 (feasible). Area down to 8.01e-10 m^2, PM up to 63.47 deg, UGBW=100.9 MHz, all hard constraints passed. Handing over to diagnoser.
Simulated id 6: mn1 reduced to 14. Reward improved to 0.6659 (feasible). Area down to 7.93e-10 m^2, PM=65.48 deg, UGBW=100.6 MHz. Handing over to diagnoser.
Simulated id 7: mn1 reduced to 12. Reward improved to 0.6686 (feasible). Area down to 7.89e-10 m^2, PM=66.53 deg, UGBW=100.3 MHz. All 5 hard constraints pass. Handing over to diagnoser.

Candidate 7 is our best feasible expert design with FoM=0.6686. All 5 hard constraints satisfied: UGBW=100.3 MHz (binding margin +0.0015), PM=66.53 deg, gain=742 V/V, SR=48 V/us, noise=16.3 mV. Area=7.89e-10 m^2, current=228.2 uA. Sizing has pushed hand equations to the margin boundary. Handing over to rl-strategist for Phase 3 refinement anchored on candidate 7.

RL Phase 3 complete: used 790 simulations (110 warmup, 680 train); total simulator calls=797. Best design improved from id 7 (FoM 0.6686) to id 351 (FoM 0.7240). 69 feasible designs generated. Key parameter shifts: cap 7e-13->6e-13, res 7k->6k, mn1 12->11, mp1 3->5, mp3 14->16, wn4 1.0u->1.25u, mn5 14->13. Ready for Phase 4 polish.

Phase 4 Polish complete: swept Rc across [5.6k, 5.8k, 6.0k, 6.2k, 6.4k, 6.6k]. Confirmed id 351 (Rc=6000) is the optimal peak with FoM 0.7240, as lower Rc violates UGBW (<100 MHz) and higher Rc increases area without improving FoM. Candidate 351 remains our best solution.

Sizing run complete: Best candidate is id 351 with FoM 0.7240 (feasible). 912 simulator calls used, 92 feasible designs found. Detailed design story, operating points, and PVT robustness analysis written to harness_runs/harness_20261107_121945/explanation.md.
